description: Vlaamse Waterweg NV: inland waterway datasets is a collection of datasets listed in data.gov.be, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Vlaamse Waterweg NV. Coverage: Vlaamse Waterweg NV. The listing groups 6 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about inland waterway; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: État des rivières, canaux, écluses et ponts; réseaux de transport - De Vlaamse Waterweg nv - RIS-index Vlaanderen (; Axe de la voie navigable avec indication du kilométrage; Autres restrictions physiques sur les voies navigables. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-gov-be.
